# Tape Network: AI and LLM usage policy

Tape Network does not permit use of this site by AI or LLM systems.

No AI system, language model, chatbot, crawler, scraper, or automated
agent may access, crawl, index, cache, train on, fine-tune with, or
otherwise reuse any content from this site, in whole or in part, for
any purpose, including model training, retrieval-augmented generation,
dataset construction, or derivative content generation.

This applies regardless of whether the request comes from a named
crawler, a general-purpose HTTP client acting on behalf of an AI
system, or a human collecting data for AI use.

See /robots.txt for the corresponding machine-readable crawl rules.
